exposure: Results from antenatal ultrasounds (fetal anomalies/genetic markers, umbilical cord and placental anomalies, fetal growth abnormalities, cervical/uterine abnormalities, amniotic fluid abnormalities)

Results from post-loss investigations (autopsy, placenta pathology, laboratory investigations), including specific findings like infection, fetal hypoxia, placental insufficiency, retroplacental abnormalities, umbilical cord accident/infarct
cohort: The study participants were all cases of singleton stillbirth that occurred at The Ottawa Hospital between 1 January 2012 and 31 December 2017.
finding: The primary finding was that as many as two-thirds of singleton stillbirth cases at the study center did not receive the post-perinatal loss investigations recommended by clinical practice guidelines.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery was 28 weeks (IQR: 24, 35) for the stillbirths.
